study type: Secondary analysis of pooled data from four randomized controlled trials.
outcome: Cesarean section for failure to progress (FTP)
Cesarean section for suspected fetal compromise (SFC)
cohort: Women undergoing induction of labor at term who had a singleton pregnancy, an unfavorable cervix, intact membranes, and the fetus in cephalic presentation.
finding: Maternal age, BMI, parity, ethnicity, and birth-weight percentile predict the risk of Cesarean section following induction of labor, with the direction and magnitude of associations differing based on the indication for Cesarean section (failure to progress vs. suspected fetal compromise).
mod_finding: Maternal and fetal characteristics were identified as predictors of Cesarean section following induction of labor, with differing associations for Cesarean section due to failure to progress versus suspected fetal compromise.
